annotation_selection.rule: All tasks, all K values and all policy seeds for the listed states.

inspection.method: Both cameras, stride-5 action frames, neighborhoods of gripper sign changes and final frame; dense windows for ambiguous contacts. Assistant visual review; no independent human annotation. Individual unknown counts retained. For object/state0, source smoke videos were decoded-frame equivalent to the main videos; review-object-state0-equivalence.json records this check.

Assistant visual inspection of both cameras for all prespecified validation states 2 and 3, all tasks and all K. Protocol sheets include stride-5 action frames, gripper sign-change neighborhoods (+/-2), last action and final outcome; denser consecutive-frame windows were inspected for ambiguous contacts. No independent human annotation. Unknown event counts remain blank and are not zeros; inspected is distinct from fully resolved reviewed=yes.
